mine2metal.screen.title: Metal Settings
mine2metal.options.metal_inactive: Not available: the game is not rendering with Metal. Set Graphics API to Default and restart.
mine2metal.options.upscaling.tooltip:
Renders the world at a lower resolution and upscales it with MetalFX for higher frame rates. Menus and the HUD stay at full resolution.

Spatial: sharpens each frame on its own.
Temporal: coming in a later version.
mine2metal.options.upscaling.unsupported: Not available: this Mac does not support MetalFX spatial upscaling.
mine2metal.options.render_scale.tooltip: How much of the window's resolution the world is rendered at before upscaling. Lower is faster but softer.
mine2metal.options.frame_interpolation.t: Coming in a later version. Will generate an extra frame between each rendered pair for smoother motion, at the cost of some input latency. Needs macOS 26 or newer.
mine2metal.options.performance_hud.toolt: Shows Apple's Metal Performance HUD in the corner of the window: frame rate, frame time graph, GPU time per frame and memory use. Measured by macOS itself, so it also shows what the game's own counters miss.
